answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a proof-of-reserves ledger entry whose balance must clear a rolling reconciliation window, so duplicate wallets surface as double-entry imbalances during the audit tide. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
